session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend from Open and Bull Trending Trading Range Day' (overnight ET+13 abacus chart, Feb 20/21). Volatile 10am ET report breakout and outside up day with 83-point range set strong bullish sentiment; double top with the week's high (23:45 high 6925) and second 01:10 major trend reversal failed tight bear leg/channel, then two legs up bull trending trading range into the close near the week's high (blue shaded box bars 60-72, chip close 6919).
